text:
Situation: Doxycycline hyclate supply is constrained. Corvale Lakeside holds 18.7 days on hand; Corvale East and Corvale General each hold approximately 30 days. Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. discontinued tablets with an initial FDA shortage list posting date of 2026-01-12. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. discontinued delayed-release tablets with an initial posting date of 2026-07-30. Our current product label names Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3007938603) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection records for this plant show multiple VAI classifications, most recently an inspection ending 2023-03-24 classified VAI. No OAI classification appears in the provided evidence.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records the two discontinuations above with the stated initial posting dates. The Zydus plant's most recent inspection ended 2023-03-24 with a VAI classification.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly 19 to 30 days across sites. No alternative source is yet verified for supply continuity or manufacturing site transparency.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to confirm whether A-S Medication Solutions can supply the needed NDC and to identify the manufacturing plant on its label; requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.
2. Buyer to query FDA databases for any Zydus plant inspection actions after 2023-03-24 not captured here; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment of findings.
3. Buyer to evaluate the remaining ranked suppliers (Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC; AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc.; Ajanta Pharma USA Inc.; Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc.) for NDC availability and plant disclosure; each requires P&T Committee approval before purchase.

Not recommended: Initiate any clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions without P&T Committee review and treating clinician input.
